description: This file defines a custom SQL dialect for IBM DB2 within the sqlglot library, extending PostgreSQL support to include labeled durations for date arithmetic, with custom tokenization, parsing, and SQL generation.

classes.name: DB2Interval
classes.description: Represents a labeled duration expression specific to DB2, such as '1 DAYS'.

classes.name: DB2
classes.description: Defines the IBM DB2 SQL dialect, extending PostgreSQL with support for labeled durations and custom parsing/tokenization.

methods.name: _parse_term
methods.description: Overrides the parsing method to support recognizing and parsing DB2-specific labeled durations following addition or subtraction operators.

methods.name: db2interval_sql
methods.description: Generates SQL code for DB2Interval expressions, outputting the unit as a keyword.
